caption: The drawing consists of a central square composed of alternating red and blue geometric patterns on a beige background. The patterns are made up of repeating smaller squares and rectangles filled with grid and dot motifs. The dominant color is red, forming larger rectangular sections which are interspersed by three horizontal blue bands; these blue bands are also filled with smaller squares and dots. The red sections are further subdivided with pale red and brownish squares, while the blue bands contain darker and lighter blue shapes. The outer border of the square is bordered by blue patterned sections on all four sides. The entire composition sits centered on a plain, off-white or light beige background with no additional objects or embellishments. There is a signature in red at the bottom right corner of the patterned square.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
